items.source: Adds an alias to an existing well-known name or registers a new instance of a PathMatcher under that well-known name, unless already registered.
items.translation: 向现有的知名名称添加别名，或者在该知名名称下注册一个新的 `PathMatcher` 实例实例（除非已注册）。

items.source: Adds an alias to an existing well-known name or registers a new instance of a PathPatternParser under that well-known name, unless already registered.
items.translation: 向现有的知名名称添加别名，或者在该知名名称下注册一个新的 PathPatternParser 实例，除非该实例已注册。

items.source: Adds an alias to an existing well-known name or registers a new instance of a UrlPathHelper under that well-known name, unless already registered.
items.translation: 向现有的知名名称添加别名，或者在该知名名称下注册一个新的 UrlPathHelper 实例（除非已注册）。

items.source: Uses of RuntimeBeanReference in org.springframework.web.servlet.config
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.servlet.config` 包中 `RuntimeBeanReference` 的用法

items.source: Registers a Map<String, CorsConfiguration> (mapped CorsConfigurations) under a well-known name unless already registered.
items.translation: 注册一个名为 `Map<String, CorsConfiguration>`（已映射的 `CorsConfiguration`）到知名名称下，除非已经注册。

items.source: Defines the XML configuration namespace for Spring MVC.
items.translation: 定义 Spring MVC 的 XML 配置命名空间。
